description: One build: install link, version, installs, release notes, permissionsPlain (each permission in plain words: what it lets the app do, the app's own iOS reason verbatim, and isNew against the previous build of the app; facts, not a safety verdict) and the store readiness check (App Store and Google Play rules) with a fix for each finding. Expo apps also get their Expo facts (SDK, expo-updates runtime version, update channel and URL, development client) and the Expo checks (development build shared with testers, test build on the production channel, runtime version against native changes). Flutter apps also get their Flutter facts (build mode, engine and Dart version, obfuscation hint, Impeller flag) and the Flutter checks (debug or profile build shared with testers). malwareScan is the check for known malware run on every upload (status pending, clean, flagged, error or skipped, and scannedAt; it only finds malware that is already known, and a flagged build is held for staff review). desktop is set for macOS and Windows builds (Pro and Team): file kind, SHA-256, minimum OS, architectures, signature (developer-id, apple, adhoc, signed, unsigned) and signer, notarization ticket stapled or not (macOS), publisher and package name; testers download the file from the install page, and readiness lists unsigned, ad hoc signed and not notarized files. Guidance only, not a promise of store approval.
